messages:
sam: Who's up for a tiny fantasy side-league for the playoffs? Loser brings chips to the next office hangout. :chip: 

joni: Count me in. What are the rules?

sam: Quick and dirty: 6 teams, 1-week playoff bracket, $10 buy-in, highest combined fantasy points wins each matchup. Single elimination.

lee: I like single elimination. Adds drama. Who drafts?

marcus: Live draft Wednesday at lunch? 12:15 in kitchen.

joni: Perfect. Can someone make a 20-min mock draft beforehand so no one panics?

sam: I'll throw together a 4-round mock in KeeperDraft app and post link.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "Fantasy side-league draft" 2026-04-08 12:15 PT. Ping #random 15m before.

lee: Also, rule add: pick changes allowed until game start time. No roster freezes until kickoff.

marcus: Fine, but tie-breaker is bench points. If still tied, rock-paper-scissors at the table.

joni: Are we doing waiver wire after each round?

sam: No waivers, just pure luck/strategy for quick fun. We can iterate later.

lee: I will lose gloriously and bring both chips and dip if that helps morale.

marcus: I'll Venmo $10 to sam tonight. Good luck.

sam: Draft link posted: https://keepdraft.example/room/quickplay (DMing invites). See y'all Wednesday.

joni: May the best non-snoozer win. :sunglasses:
